lessons.title: evidence, threat, take over, injure,
lessons.contentHtml:
Read the text and do the task.

Life in space is still a mystery, but scientists look for evidence of living things on other planets. Some people believe that aliens are real and could be a threat to humans. They fear that one day, aliens might take over Earth. If these space creatures are dangerous, they could injure people or destroy cities. However, there is no real proof yet, and many scientists think that if life exists in space, it may not be dangerous at all.
